 Original documents must be submitted. Photocopies or English translations alone are not accepted as originals. (Ex. Birth Certificates, Marriage Certificates, Police Reports, etc.).

summary: The Sri Lanka High Commission page lowered the application age limit for unmarried children in Category G from 21 years 6 months to 21 years (from 1 Oct 2026) and now asks for double-sided photocopies; the dual-citizenship framework itself is unchanged.

resolution.note: Sri Lanka's London High Commission tightened the age limit for children applying for dual citizenship; our 'restricted' summary still holds.
